item: The drain's catch-up reads only followed pages, backs off failing ones and survives one page's store failing
status: shipped (fixture-verified; awaiting the operator's 72 h run)
summary: Two Opus reviews of #1269/#1270 found that the catch-up never released a page holding only a baseline (ingested_revision_id stays NULL for it), so every followed page would be re-fetched every drain; the backlog is now the changes newer than the last STORED text (last_checked_at is written only on a stored text), read with one EXISTS that seeks the (entity_id, occurred_at) index (0.19 s for 12 feeds over 500k changes). A failed or refused page is left alone for 5 minutes by an in-process attempts map; a store that raises (even in a flush) is rolled back in a savepoint, with the corpus session, and named; backlog pages are reported as text_backlog instead of being counted deferred again.
